text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break one day, I spot Vivlos 
hanging out with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Now that we're done with lunch, wanna go 
get moving and active~?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's play some basketball in 
the gym—wait, huh? Who's that... They 
aren't a student here, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of their gaze stood an 
unfamiliar horse girl. She was wearing 
what appeared to be traditional ethnic 
attire...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This lady is from a lineage of Dubai oil 
barons. With me as her guide, she is 
currently experiencing Tracen Academy♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A-An oil baron...!!? Then, does that 
mean—she's a super-celebrity oil baron 
horse girl~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, if that's the deal, I'll happily 
show her around! First off, this right 
here is the cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We got a solid lineup of drinks, too. Why 
don't you try some! My recommendation is 
this black coffee—

text_block_list.name: Oil Baron Horse Girl's Bodyguard
text_block_list.text:
[—Hold, Milady!! We shall test it for 
poison first!!]

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what the hell?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems they're saying they must 
test it for poison first.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
P-Poison testing...?! It ain't anything 
dangerous like that...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This is the gym. We train our bodies here 
to prepare for races. Would you like to 
give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Oil Baron Horse Girl's Bodyguard
text_block_list.text:
[—Wait, my Lady!! Heavy tools are 
dangerous!!]

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? H-Hold on— It's really not something 
to be that guarded about, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's pretty intense...~ Is this what 
it's really like to be a celebrity...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she won't get to experience 
anything... I wish she could at least 
relax a little.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm, in that case... —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There aren't any dangerous things at the 
dorms, so it should be totally safe, 
right? —You know, this is where we all 
live!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The laundry room is always super packed 
every day, and we have to share the TV, so 
it's not all sparkly like a celebrity's 
life, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We're together with our friends and big 
sisters, so it's lots of fun☆

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, when ya think about it, havin' 
people around ain't so bad.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I get hungry in the middle of the 
night and head to the dining hall, there's 
almost always someone doing the same thing 
who shares their snack with me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And whenever you want to train or practice 
for a live performance, you can instantly 
ask someone to join you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ? What did she say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's see... It seems she said this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of being a runner, I chose a 
career supporting the races."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I find great meaning in my work, and I am 
very satisfied with my current 
environment, however—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I have never experienced communal living 
like this before, nor will I in the 
future. I've always wanted to try it at 
least once—she says."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Even for the little things, she's watched 
or stopped by someone—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Even everyday stuff that's totally normal 
for us is difficult for her... 
...Celebrities really do have so many hard 
things to deal with, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was quite a valuable experience 
today, wasn't it, Vivlos-chan?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Vivlos-chan? You look deep in 
thought, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah—no! It's nothing at all! I was just 
thinking again how I definitely want to 
become a celebrity someday~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Yes, indeed.
